interface_decision.semantic_role: general finite function-space cardinality used by cyclic-tuple counting in Cauchy's theorem
interface_decision.litex_form: an explicit one-point extension bijection followed by finite-set induction

proof_spine: A function on the empty set is the unique empty-domain function.
A function on {z} union S is equivalent to a function on S together with one value at z.
The explicit extension map is injective and surjective.
Finite-set induction turns the one-point product recurrence into |B|^|A|.

blocks.name: empty_function_space_singleton

attempts.verifier_evidence: Literal outer try committed; verify_well_definedness, verify_process, and affect_environment all returned Success.

blocks.accepted_litex:
thm empty_function_space_singleton:
    ? forall B nonempty_set, b B:
        fn(input {}) B = {fn(input {}) B {b}}
    claim:
        ? forall f fn(input {}) B:
            f = fn(input {}) B {b}
        claim:
            ? forall empty_input {}:
                f(empty_input) = fn(input {}) B {b}(empty_input)
            by contra:
                ? f(empty_input) = fn(input {}) B {b}(empty_input)
                impossible empty_input $in {}
        by def:
            ? $fn_eq(f, fn(input {}) B {b})
    by extension:
        ? fn(input {}) B = {fn(input {}) B {b}}
        claim:
            ? forall f fn(input {}) B:
                f $in {fn(input {}) B {b}}
            f = fn(input {}) B {b}
        claim:
            ? forall f {fn(input {}) B {b}}:
                f $in fn(input {}) B
